summary.content: The Obsidian Archive hummed with the low thrum of eternal memory. Scribe Elara watched as two copies of the latest ledger entry were etched into the black stone. The expedition had departed on a stormy Tuesday, carrying rare spices and a crew of twelve. The route wound through the Shattered Peaks, where weather shifted from blinding snow to scorching heat at every waypoint. Elara’s eyes darted between the twin inscriptions, searching for discrepancies. A single char in the second copy’s "weather" line made her pause. Was it a flaw in the stone, or a ghost in the data? She traced the error, feeling the cold obsidian yield slightly under her thumb. If the copies didn't match, the archive would reject the entry, sending the expedition’s history back into the void. With a steady hand, she corrected the char. The ledger accepted the truth. Silence returned, heavy and permanent.
